This '''national electoral calendar for 2012''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2012 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*3–4 January: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (3rd phase 1st round)]]
*10–11 January: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2011–12 Egyptian parliamentary election|People's Assembly (3rd phase 2nd round)]]
*13 January: [[Elections in Kiribati|Kiribati]], [[2012 Kiribati presidential election|President]]
*14 January: [[Elections in Taiwan|Taiwan]], [[2012 Taiwanese presidential election|President]] and [[2012 Taiwanese legislative election|Parliament]]
*15 January: [[Elections in Kazakhstan|Kazakhstan]], [[2012 Kazakhstani legislative election|Assembly]]
*22 January: 
**[[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[2012 Croatian European Union membership referendum|EU Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2012 Finnish presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*29–30 January: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian Shura Council election|Consultative Council (1st phase 1st round)]]

==February==
*2 February: [[Elections in Kuwait|Kuwait]], [[February 2012 Kuwaiti parliamentary election|<s>Parliament</s>]] (election nullified)
*5 February: [[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2012 Finnish presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*5–6 February: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian Shura Council election|Consultative Council (1st phase 2nd round)]]
*12 February: [[Elections in Turkmenistan|Turkmenistan]], [[2012 Turkmenistani presidential election|President]]
*14–15 February: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian Shura Council election|Consultative Council (2nd phase 1st round)]]
*18 February: [[Elections in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2012 Latvian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*19–21 February: ''[[Elections in the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic|Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic]], [[2012 Sahrawi legislative election|Parliament]]''
*21 February: [[Elections in Yemen|Yemen]], [[2012 Yemeni presidential election|President]]
*21–22 February: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian Shura Council election|Consultative Council (2nd phase 2nd round)]]
*26 February: 
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2012 Senegalese presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Syria|Syria]], [[2012 Syrian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]

==March==
*2 March: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2012 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]]
*4 March: [[Elections in Russia|Russia]], [[2012 Russian presidential election|President]]
*7 March: [[Elections in Belize|Belize]], [[2012 Belizean general election|House of Representatives]]
*10 March: 
**''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2012 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]''
**[[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2012 Slovak parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*11 March: 
**[[Elections in El Salvador|El Salvador]], [[2012 Salvadoran legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2012 Swiss referendums#March referendums|Referendums]]
*17 March: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2012 East Timorese presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*18 March: 
**[[Elections in Guinea-Bissau|Guinea-Bissau]], [[2012 Guinea-Bissau presidential election|<s>President (1st round)</s>]] (election nullified)
**''[[Elections in Saint Barthélemy|Saint Barthélemy]], [[2011 Saint Barthélemy Territorial Council election|Legislature]]''
**''[[Elections in the Collectivity of Saint Martin|Saint Martin]], [[2011 Saint Martin Territorial Council election|Legislature]]''
**''[[Elections in Saint Pierre and Miquelon|Saint Pierre and Miquelon]], [[2012 Saint Pierre and Miquelon legislative election|Legislature]]''
*24 March: ''[[Elections in Abkhazia|Abkhazia]], [[2012 Abkhazian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]''
*25 March: 
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2012 Senegalese presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2012 Slovenian Family Code referendum|Referendum]]
**''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2012 South Ossetian presidential election|President (1st round)]]''
**''[[Elections in Wallis and Futuna|Wallis and Futuna]], [[2012 Wallis and Futuna Territorial Assembly election|Legislature]]''
*29 March: [[Elections in the Gambia|The Gambia]], [[2012 Gambian parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==April==
*8 April: ''[[Elections in South Ossetia|South Ossetia]], [[2012 South Ossetian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]''
*11 April: [[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2012 South Korean legislative election|Parliament]]
*16 April: [[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2012 East Timorese presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*18 April: ''[[Elections in Guernsey|Guernsey]], [[2012 Guernsey general election|Legislature]]''
*22 April: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2012 French presidential election|President (1st round)]]

==May==
*3 May: ''[[Elections in the Faroe Islands|Faroe Islands]], [[2012 Faroese municipal merger referendum|Referendum]]''
*4 May: [[Elections in Iran|Iran]], [[2012 Iranian legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
*6 May: 
**[[Elections in Armenia|Armenia]], [[2012 Armenian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in France|France]], [[2012 French presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[May 2012 Greek legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2012 Serbian presidential election|President (1st round)]] and [[2012 Serbian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*7 May: 
**[[Elections in the Bahamas|Bahamas]], [[2012 Bahamian general election|House of Assembly]]
**[[Elections in Syria|Syria]], [[2012 Syrian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*10 May: [[Elections in Algeria|Algeria]], [[2012 Algerian legislative election|National Assembly]]
*20 May: 
**[[Elections in the Dominican Republic|Dominican Republic]], [[2012 Dominican Republic presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Serbia|Serbia]], [[2012 Serbian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*23–24 May: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*26 May: [[Elections in Lesotho|Lesotho]], [[2012 Lesotho general election|National Assembly]]
*31 May: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[Thirtieth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland|Constitutional Referendum]]

==June==
*10 June: [[Elections in France|France]], [[2012 French legislative election|Parliament (1st round)]]
*16–17 June: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*17 June: 
**[[Elections in France|France]], [[2012 French legislative election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[June 2012 Greek legislative election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2012 Swiss referendums#June referendums|Referendums]]
*23 June – 13 July: [[Elections in Papua New Guinea|Papua New Guinea]], [[2012 Papua New Guinean general election|Parliament]]
*28 June: [[Elections in Mongolia|Mongolia]], [[2012 Mongolian legislative election|Parliament]]
*30 June: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2012 Icelandic presidential election|President]]

==July==
*1 July: 
**[[Elections in Liechtenstein|Liechtenstein]], [[2012 Liechtenstein constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Mexico|Mexico]], [[2012 Mexican general election|President, Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
**[[Elections in Senegal|Senegal]], [[2012 Senegalese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*7 July: 
**[[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2012 East Timorese parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Libya|Libya]], [[2012 Libyan General National Congress election|General National Congress]]
*15 July: [[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2012 Republic of the Congo parliamentary election|National Assembly (1st round)]]
*18 July: ''[[Elections in the Cayman Islands|Cayman Islands]], [[2012 Caymanian electoral system referendum|Referendum]]''
*19 July: ''[[Elections in Artsakh|Nagorno-Karabakh]], [[2012 Nagorno-Karabakh presidential election|President]]''
*29 July: 
**[[Elections in the Republic of the Congo|Republic of the Congo]], [[2012 Republic of the Congo parliamentary election|National Assembly (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Romania|Romania]], [[2012 Romanian presidential impeachment referendum|Impeachment Referendum]]

==August==
*19 August: ''[[Elections in Puerto Rico|Puerto Rico]], [[2012 Puerto Rican constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]''
*31 August: [[Elections in Angola|Angola]], [[2012 Angolan legislative election|Parliament]]

==September==
*9 September: ''[[Elections in Hong Kong|Hong Kong]], [[2012 Hong Kong legislative election|Legislature]]''
*12 September: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2012 Dutch general election|House of Representatives]]
*23 September: 
**[[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2012 Belarusian parliamentary election|House of Representatives]]
**''[[Politics of the Pitcairn Islands|Pitcairn Islands]], [[2012 Pitcairnese marine reserve referendum|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pewtrusts.org/en/about/news-room/press-releases-and-statements/2012/09/27/pitcairn-in-support-of-a-marine-reserve|title=Pitcairn in Support of a Marine Reserve!|publisher=[[The Pew Charitable Trusts]]|date=27 September 2012|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2012 Swiss referendums#September referendums|Referendums]]

==October==
*1 October: [[Elections in Georgia (country)|Georgia]], [[2012 Georgian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*7 October: [[Elections in Venezuela|Venezuela]], [[2012 Venezuelan presidential election|President]]
*12–13 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2012 Czech Senate election|Senate (1st round)]]
*14 October: 
**[[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2012 Lithuanian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]] and [[2012 Lithuanian nuclear power referendum|Referendum]]
**[[Elections in Montenegro|Montenegro]], [[2012 Montenegrin parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*19 October: ''[[Elections in Curaçao|Curaçao]], [[2012 Curaçao general election|Legislature]]''
*19–20 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2012 Czech Senate election|Senate (2nd round)]]
*20 October: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2012 Icelandic constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]
*28 October: 
**[[Elections in Lithuania|Lithuania]], [[2012 Lithuanian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2012 Ukrainian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*30 October: [[Elections in Vanuatu|Vanuatu]], [[2012 Vanuatuan general election|Parliament]]

==November==
*6 November: 
**[[Elections in Palau|Palau]], [[2012 Palauan presidential election|President]] and [[2012 Palauan general election|House of Delegates and Senate]]
**[[Elections in the United States|United States]], [[2012 United States presidential election|President]], [[2012 United States House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2012 United States Senate elections|Senate]]
***''[[Elections in American Samoa|American Samoa]], [[2012 American Samoa gubernatorial election|Governor (1st round)]], [[2012 American Samoan general election|House of Representatives]] and [[2012 American Samoan general election#Referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]''
***''[[Elections in Guam|Guam]], [[2012 Guamanian general election|Auditor, Consolidated Commission on Utilities, Education Board]], [[2012 Guamanian legislative election|Legislature]], [[2012 Guamanian general election|Superior Court retention elections]] and [[2012 Guamanian legislative election|Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BScF5jhvE01V_t5Qoe7zgp2sw1VYe6Fb/view|title=2012 Election Comparative Analysis Report|publisher=Guam Election Commission|date=5 July 2013|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
***''[[Elections in the Northern Mariana Islands|Northern Mariana Islands]], [[2012 Northern Mariana Islands general election|House of Representatives, Senate, Supreme Court retention elections]] and [[2012 Northern Mariana Islands constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.votecnmi.gov.mp/2012-election-results-mp.php|title=Official CNMI 2012 Election Results|publisher=Commonwealth Election Commission|date=9 November 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131022044033/https://www.votecnmi.gov.mp/2012-election-results-mp.php|archive-date=22 October 2013|url-status=dead}}</ref>
***''[[Elections in Puerto Rico|Puerto Rico]], [[2012 Puerto Rico gubernatorial election|Governor]], [[2012 Puerto Rican general election|House of Representatives, Senate]] and [[2012 Puerto Rican status referendum|Referendum]]''
***''[[Elections in the U.S. Virgin Islands|U.S. Virgin Islands]], [[2012 United States Virgin Islands general election|Board of Education, Board of Elections, Legislature]] and [[2012 United States Virgin Islands hemp referendum|Referendum]]''
*9 November: ''[[Elections in the Turks and Caicos Islands|Turks and Caicos Islands]], [[2012 Turks and Caicos Islands general election|Legislature]]''
*10 November: [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[Thirty-first Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland|Constitutional Referendum]]
*11 November: 
**[[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[2012 Sammarinese general election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2012 Slovenian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*17 November: [[Elections in Sierra Leone|Sierra Leone]], [[2012 Sierra Leonean general election|President and Parliament]]
*20 November: ''[[Elections in American Samoa|American Samoa]], [[2012 American Samoa gubernatorial election|Governor (2nd round)]]''
*25 November: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2012 Swiss referendums#November referendum|Referendum]]

==December==
*1 December: [[Elections in Kuwait|Kuwait]], [[December 2012 Kuwaiti parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*2 December: 
**[[Elections in Burkina Faso|Burkina Faso]], [[2012 Burkinabé parliamentary election|Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2012 Slovenian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*7–8 December: [[Elections in Ghana|Ghana]], [[2012 Ghanaian presidential election|President and Parliament]]
*9 December: [[Elections in Romania|Romania]], [[2012 Romanian legislative election|Chamber of Deputies and Senate]]
*15 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum (1st phase)]]
*16 December: [[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2012 Japanese general election|House of Representatives]] and {{ill|2012 Japanese retention election|lt=Supreme Court retention elections|ja|2012年最高裁判所裁判官国民審査}}
*17 December: ''[[Elections in Bermuda|Bermuda]], [[2012 Bermudan general election|House of Assembly]]''
*19 December: [[Elections in South Korea|South Korea]], [[2012 South Korean presidential election|President]]
*22 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2012 Egyptian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum (2nd phase)]]

==Indirect elections==
The following [[indirect election]]s of [[head of state|heads of state]] and the [[upper house]]s of bicameral legislatures took place through votes in elected [[lower house]]s, [[Unicameralism|unicameral legislatures]], or [[electoral college]]s: 
*3 January: [[Elections in the Marshall Islands|Marshall Islands]], [[2012 Marshallese presidential election|President]]
*11 January and 16 March: [[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2011–2012 Moldovan presidential election|President]]
*19 January, 30 March, and 25 June: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2012 Rajya Sabha elections|Council of States]]
*29 January: [[Elections in Cambodia|Cambodia]], [[2012 Cambodian Senate election|Senate]]
*2 March: [[Elections in Pakistan|Pakistan]], [[2012 Pakistani Senate election|Senate]]
*18 March: [[Elections in Germany|Germany]], [[2012 German presidential election|President]]
*25 March: ''[[Elections in Hong Kong|Hong Kong]], [[2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election|Chief Executive]]''
*1 April: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*2 May: [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2012 Hungarian presidential election|President]]
*30 May, 4, 8 and 11 June: [[Elections in Albania|Albania]], [[2012 Albanian presidential election|President]]
*30 June – 30 September: [[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2012 Belarusian Council of the Republic election|Council of the Republic]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://regnum.ru/news/polit/1555607.html|title=CEC of Belarus did not register oppositionists as candidates for deputies|work=[[REGNUM News Agency]]|language=ru|date=26 July 2012|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*19 July: 
**[[Elections in India|India]], [[2012 Indian presidential election|President]]
**[[Elections in Samoa|Samoa]], [[2012 Samoan o le Ao o le Malo election|Head of the Government]]
*20 July: [[Elections in Mauritius|Mauritius]], [[2012 Mauritian presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.defimedia.info/news-sunday/nos-parliament/item/16284-national-assembly-%E2%80%93-speaker-becomes-president-of-the-republic-new-speaker-takes-office.html|title=National Assembly – Speaker becomes President of the Republic New Speaker takes office|publisher=[[Le Défi Media Group]]|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120818134332/http://www.defimedia.info/news-sunday/nos-parliament/item/16284-national-assembly-%E2%80%93-speaker-becomes-president-of-the-republic-new-speaker-takes-office.html|date=27 July 2012|archive-date=18 August 2012|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*7 August: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2012 Indian vice presidential election|Vice President]]
*17 September: [[Elections in Dominica|Dominica]], [[2012 Dominican presidential election|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://ktar.com/story/228409/dominica-chooses-new-president-despite-boycott/|title=Dominica chooses new president despite boycott|work=[[KTAR-FM]]|date=18 September 2012|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*28 September: [[Elections in Morocco|Morocco]], [[2012 Moroccan House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://albayane.press.ma/chambre-des-conseillers-renouvellement-du-tiers-sortant-le-28-septembre-prochain.html|title=Chamber of Councilors: Renewal of the outgoing third party on September 28|work=[[Al Bayane]]|language=fr|date=5 August 2012|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*1 October: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*21–22 November: [[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2012 Slovenian National Council election|National Council]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.posavskiobzornik.si/novice/dravni-svetnik-iz-posavja-bo-znova-joe-slivek|title=The state councilor from Posavje will again be Jože Slivšek|work=Posavski obzornik|language=sl|date=30 November 2012|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*29 December: [[Elections in Algeria|Algeria]], [[2012 Algerian Council of the Nation election|Council of the Nation]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.liberte-algerie.com/actualite/les-48-nouveaux-senateurs-connus-117680/print/1|title=Council of the Nation: The 48 new senators known|work=[[Liberté (Algeria)|Liberté]]|language=fr|date=2 January 2013|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
